bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 30 (Thursday, February 12, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. GOODLANDER:
H.R. 7537.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8 of the U.S. Constitution
[Page H2220]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
